test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: At what rate of simple interest per annum will a sum of money get doubled in 10 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 10 years, Final Amount = 2 × Principal (Doubling)

Formula:

Interest = Principal × Rate × Time / 100

**Calculation:**

Let Principal = P, Rate = R%

Doubling means Final Amount = 2P

Interest earned = 2P - P = P

For doubling in 10 years:

⇒ P = P × R × 10 / 100

⇒ 100 = R × 10

⇒ R = 100 / 10

⇒ R = 10%

**Rate = 10% per annum**
